newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE FIRST TIER UP IN BULL RUN.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE FIRST TIER UP IN BULL RUN.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse's first
tier pushed higher on Tuesday under a strong rally extending
from last week, with three of its four high-caps gaining
further ground and volumes rising from the previous session.
Two independent indices climbed to year highs for the
second consecutive trading day.
"There is strong interest from foreign investors, who seem
to prefer companies in Romania's chemical and pharmaceuticals
sectors and the first tier trades just that," a broker said.
Fertiliser maker Azomures was the first tier's
leading gainer, putting on 100 lei to close at 1,980. Oltchim
chemical plant ended 30 lei stronger at 1,400 and
Terapia pharmaceuticals maker firmed 50 lei to 3,350.
The tier's other pharmaceuticals company, Antibiotice
closed flat at 4,000 lei.
Traders said they expected the bullish tone to keep the
first tier in its grip throughout the week.
"There seems to be several foreign investors eager to get a
significant stake of more than five percent in first-tier
stocks. They seem willing to pay high prices," one said.
The second tier put on a lacklustre show, with shares
tracking sideways. Buyers targeted dye maker Policolor, whose price rose by 50 lei to 2,350.
Six of the second tier's 30 stocks had no trade and four
were suspended pending announcements.
"With investors focusing the first tier, trading in the
lower category will stay subdued this week, when I expect most
prices to drift lower on profit-taking ahead of (Orthodox)
Easter on Sunday," another broker said.
Steel pipe maker Ciprom and Sinterom engineering company joined the second tier on Tuesday. Ciprom
doubled its opening quote to end at 600 lei, while Sinterom did
not trade in the absence of sell notes.
The VAB and the BIG indices rose by 2.6 and 2.66 percent
respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier
index jumped 4.30 percent to 1,964.49 points.
